verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own documentation covers a full terminal environment and a first-party Linux command-line tutorial, and lets users change the default terminal. That is an official CLI as part of the OS itself. However, nothing in the evidence shows it is designed for or documented for AI-native or agentic workflows, such as a scriptable product CLI aimed at agents. Missing for 10: AI- or agent-oriented CLI tooling or docs, structured/machine-readable output for agents, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.
